title: Leaving the program via a Don't Ask Don't Tell letter
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Leaving the program via a Don't Ask Don't Tell letter, about early-mid 1990s at Base 2, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: admitted I said I wrote a letter to my commander

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant, says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that handles communications, trained him to receive messages from aliens at a place he calls Base 2. He says that in the early 1990s he got out of that programme by writing a letter to his commander, tied to Don't Ask Don't Tell, the US military's rule of the time on gay service members. He tells it as the way he was able to leave something otherwise hard to walk away from.
